title: mineHomes
description: mineHomes Fast, Free, Lightweight. Best Free Home Plugin.
body:
# Introducing mineHomes
## What is DonutHome?
**mineHomes** is a high performance Minecraft 1.16.5+ plugin packed with **powerful features** and **optimized for smooth gameplay**.
## Features
- GUI for normal players so they can view, manage and teleport to their homes
- Full admin control over player homes
## Build-in Admin commands
- check player homes
- delete player homes
- teleport to player homes
- reset all homes for a player
## Messages
Interactive chat messages and GUI lore for better feel

Confirmation System so you don't accidentally delete a home
## Integration & Migration
If you switch to mineHOMES, you won't lose data, with automatic 1-click homes from EssentialsX migrate system!
## WorldGuard Integration
If WorldGuard is installed, the plugin will automatically respect region flags. Players won't be able to set homes in restricted areas.
## MySQL - SQLite
MySQL and SQLite support! Zero-setup SQLite local database (homes.db) or multi-server MySQL synchronization for networks.
# Plugin Usage
- /homes /mh / home | minehomes.command.homes
- /sethome < 1-5 > | minehomes.command.sethome
- /delhome < 1-5 > | minehomes.command.delhome
- /minehomes < reload / reset / list / visit > | minehomes.admin
